```text
# PR #3861: Patch: the account screen as a profile and a settings list: a profile header, match history, and sign-in, notifications and privacy each in its own section

Closes #3733

## What changed

`/account` is now a profile header over a settings list. On a wide window (over 600 px) the list sits beside the open section. On a phone (600 px and under), `/account` is the list and a section opens alone, so Back returns to the list.

- **Sections.** Overview, Match history, Sign-in & security, Notifications, Privacy & data and Delete account. Each has its own URL, `/account?section=<id>`, and only the open section mounts. Sign out is at the foot of the list.
  - A pending account sees Overview, Sign-in & security, Privacy & data and Delete account.
  - A section's own "‹ Account" link is the way back to the list from a deep link on a phone.
  - A waiting provider-link result (R3025000, R3147002) opens Sign-in & security once, on mount, by a replacing navigation.
- **Header.**
  - The header shows the portrait, `name#tag` with Copy, "Member since", and each ladder's crest, division, season record and streak flame.
  - It keeps the `account-rank`, season-record and random-rank test ids.
- **Match history.** The newest `ACCOUNT_HISTORY_ROWS` (10) games from `/api/replays`, worded as `/replays` words them, each with Watch replay linking to `/replays`.
  - The wording (`RESULT_WORDS`, `MODE_WORDS`, `opponentName`, `unavailableText`) moved to `routes/replayWords.ts`. `replays.tsx` imports it back, and the account stays out of `replays.tsx`'s chunk.
  - A failed history read shows an alert with Try again and leaves the rest of the screen alone.
- **Notifications.** `NotificationSettings` moved verbatim from `DailyRoute` to `daily/NotificationSettings.tsx`. `/daily` imports it, and `/account` renders it.
- **Server.** `GET /api/profile` now carries `createdAt` (epoch ms). It is optional in the client, so an older server shows no "Member since".
- **Spec.** `spec/rulings/R3733000.md` and `spec/pending/3733.md`, plus the READMEs and `docs/deploy-cloudflare.md` lines that named the removed "Manage sign-in & account" disclosure.
- **Removed.** `account-manage*`, the disclosure itself, and the two `zh-CN` entries for its labels.

## Tests I ran

- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r3733000`: passes. The test is in `--test server`, not `--test api` as the plan said.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `pnpm exec vitest run src/routes src/daily src/i18n src/writing.test.ts src/wording.test.ts src/breakpoints.test.ts`: 68 files, 1463 tests passed. An earlier run that also included `src/shell` passed 69 files.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`: clean.
- eslint on `apps/web/src/routes`, `apps/web/src/daily`, `apps/web/src/net`, the component spec and the smoke spec: clean.
- `pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/account-screen.cy.tsx`: 14 of 14 pass. It checks no horizontal overflow and no page scroll at all seven `MENU_SIZES`, then list and section visibility at `/account` and at `?section=history`.
- `account.test.tsx` moved to the new layout.
- `account-sections.test.tsx` is new and holds the reachability list and the queue-opponent test.
- `account-reads.test.tsx` has the one new `/api/auth/me` read-count test.
- The smoke spec's first `/account` visit now uses `?section=overview`.

I did not run the whole `--changed origin/main` web suite (it timed out at 10 minutes here), so the harness's run is the first full one. I did not take screenshots at `MENU_SIZES`, so the acceptance item for them is not met.

## Departures from the plan, and decisions

- **`accountSectionPath` instead of `paths.accountSection`.** The function is in `routes/accountSections.ts`. `MenuShell.test.tsx` calls every function in `paths` with `"cards"`, and a section union made that a type error. Rejected: widening it to `string`, or editing that test.
- **Pending account's header.** A pending account has no header, and its email and status are in Overview only. The plan put them in both places, which would have duplicated the test ids.
- **Link-result redirect.** It runs once, guarded by a ref, and `data-open` follows the URL alone. The plan's `linkWaiting` flag would have kept a phone on Sign-in & security after pressing the in-page back link.
- **Header portrait.** It is the newest kept online game's portrait for the player's seat, else `vanilla`. No account has an equipped portrait (R641, R1827000). Rejected: a new account cosmetic, and the most-played deck's portrait.
- **Watch replay.** It links to `/replays`, not to one game, since `/replays` has no deep link. Rejected: a `?match=` deep link, which would be a change of its own.
- **Reveal button.** The secret-ID button now says "Reveal" under an always-visible "Account secret ID" label. The test id is unchanged.
- **Linked accounts.** `LinkedAccounts` already shows a Roblox avatar (R3507000). The other providers show names only, so the issue's "names and avatars" is met for Roblox only.
- **`LinkedAccounts` not tested.** It renders nothing in the unit-test environment (no provider list), so the reachability table has no row for it. Its code is untouched.
- **Nested Notifications heading.** The section's own `<h2>` wraps `NotificationSettings`, which has an `<h2>` of its own. The two share a name, which I left alone to keep `/daily`'s panel verbatim.
- **Section subheadings.** The header's ladder labels are paragraphs, not headings, because `expectOnePageTitle` rejects an h3 straight under the h1.

## For the reviewer
